name: reachinbox-scheduler-monorepo
description: Production-grade distributed email scheduler with BullMQ, Redis, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and Next.js

scripts.build:packages: npm --workspace=@reachinbox/shared run build && npm --workspace=@reachinbox/database run build && npm --workspace=@reachinbox/queue run build
scripts.build:apps: npm --workspace=@reachinbox/api run build && npm --workspace=@reachinbox/scheduler run build && npm --workspace=@reachinbox/worker run build && npm --workspace=@reachinbox/search run build && npm --workspace=@reachinbox/gateway run build && npm --workspace=@reachinbox/web run build
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
